name: material-literature-workbench
description: 材料科学文献知识库桌面工作台
author: Material Literature Agent

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix server run dev" "vite --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:8787/api/v1/health http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k "npm --prefix server start" "wait-on http://localhost:8787/api/v1/health && electron ."
scripts.smoke: npm run build && concurrently -k "npm --prefix server start" "wait-on http://localhost:8787/api/v1/health && cross-env ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 SMOKE_OUTPUT=smoke.png electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && npm --prefix server run typecheck
